ui_clipboard_help.message: Copied passwords are cleared after 30 seconds. With this on, Nedra first checks the clipboard still holds its copy, so it never wipes something you copied since. Your browser will ask to let it read the clipboard.

ui_firefox_shortcuts.message: To change them, open about:addons, click the gear icon and choose “Manage Extension Shortcuts”.

ui_about_description.message: Nedra extension $ARG1$. No Nedra account, ever. The extension comes from your browser's store, which sees the install like any extension. It only ever talks to your own Nedra, and only when you ask it to fill. Only the page's origin is sent to find matches, never its path or contents. No favicons, no analytics, no remote configuration.
